marketplace.name: mw-agent-tools
marketplace.description: Tools that keep coding agents working while you are away.

plugins.name: keep-going
plugins.description: Wakes an idle agent session when work is still pending, at no model cost when nothing is.

plugins.name: autonomy
plugins.description: For when you step away: gathers every sign-in, approval and decision up front, then works on best judgement and logs each call with its undo path.

plugins.name: digest
plugins.description: One-screen catch-up when you return: work items with status and progress, then what happened while you were away.

plugins.name: worklog
plugins.description: Keeps a running log of milestones, decisions and status so you can see where things stand at any time.
